testcase.name: Scenario: Report an unevaluable model-state parameter equation: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/model-browser-published-snapshot/checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1451:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Report an unevaluable model-state parameter equation ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user opens the model-state table and adds length parameter d0 to the table ✔ And The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing the length parameter d0 ✔ And no parameter named abc exists in the part ✔ When the user replaces the active member d0 value with "abc" and presses Enter ✔ Then the d0 cell displays "abc" with a yellow background ✔ And OK remains enabled ✔ When the user selects Verify ✔ Then the yellow d0 cell remains visible ✔ And no separate message is displayed ✔ When the user selects OK ✔ Then a message reports an error in the table and identifies the unevaluable d0 equation "abc" ✔ When the user dismisses the message ✔ Then the model-state table remains open with "abc" in the d0 cell ✔ When the user cancels the table ✔ Then the table closes without accepting the entry
